career_path_block.说明: Taken over by AI and disconnected from students

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but burnout. Teachers who sustain emotional and physical energy can wait long enough to see children's progress.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is not AI but burnout. Students have specialized needs, family-school communication is demanding, caseloads can exceed standards, and both emotional and physical depletion are significant. Special education teacher turnover remains substantial.
risks: High burnout and emotional depletion, with substantial turnover
Class sizes and case complexity rise each year
Complicated family-school communication stretches boundaries indefinitely
Large regional differences in staffing and compensation, with underinvestment in some areas
Heavy desk documentation displaces genuine teaching time

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can write IEPs, generate lesson plans, and grade work, but special education teachers will always decide whether a child is willing to learn today and how to encourage willingness next time.

responsibilities: Document progress and communicate with parents
Participate in IEP meetings and transition assessments

career_path_block.说明: 市场化，跟政策补贴波动
被 AI 接管，且远离学生

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「倦怠」——撑住情绪和体力的老师，才能等到那些孩子的改变。
career_risk_cards.fact: 最大的风险不是 AI，而是「职业倦怠」：教学对象特殊、家校沟通繁重、个别人数超编，情绪和体力消耗都大，特教老师的流失率一直不低。
risks: 职业倦怠与情绪消耗大，流失率不低
班额和个案复杂程度逐年上升
家校沟通繁琐，边界容易被无限拉扯
编制和待遇地区差异大，部分地区投入不足
案头文书繁重，挤占真正教学时间

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能写 IEP、出教案、批作业，但「这个孩子今天愿不愿意学、下次怎么让他愿意」——这个判断，永远在特教老师手里。

responsibilities: 实施个别化教学与干预
参与 IEP 会议与转衔评估
skills: 分层教学与差异化设计
家校沟通与跨专业协作
辅助技术与教学工具使用
